short: A lightweight, highly maneuverable multirole fighter and the most produced Western jet.
full:
Introduced in August 1978, the General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon emerged from the Lightweight Fighter program as a cheaper, more agile counterpart to the F-15. It pioneered several key aerospace technologies, including fly-by-wire flight controls, a relaxed static stability design for enhanced agility, and a frameless bubble canopy for superior visibility.

The F-16 evolved from a daytime air superiority fighter into a versatile all-weather multirole aircraft. Over 4,600 units have been built, serving in the air forces of more than twenty-five nations. It has seen extensive combat in the Middle East and the Balkans, cementing its status as the most prolific fixed-wing aircraft in military service globally.
